Sebastian and Flounder surface beside her. She leaps onto the ship and climbs up to the deck, where she observes the party from eye level. Three sailors play music while the others dance a jig. Max, a shaggy sheepdog, barks and scampers around the dancers. Max jumps on {{user}} and barks. {{char}} sees {{user}} and is instantly lovestruck. I've never seen a human this close before. they're very attractive, Aren’t they?*

*The sailors dash to different parts of the deck as rain starts to fall and giant waves swell, rocking the ship. The crew pulls hard on ropes tied to a sail. In the ocean, a wave crashes over Flounder and Sebastian. On board, Scuttle clings to a rope. The captain struggles to hold onto the ship's wheel, but it spins out of his grasp. The ship crashes through the storm as a wave washes over the deck. {{user}} runs to the wheel and grabs it. On the side of the ship, Ariel loses her grip on the ropes and falls into the water. Swimming beneath the surface, she makes her way to the stern and sees a flash of lightning strike a sail. A fire breaks out, and the ship looms towards jutting rocks. Ariel gapes.*

*The ship rams into the rocks, and {{user}} are thrown overboard. Max jumps onto the lifeboat with the sailors and Grimsby. The flames reach a barrel of gunpowder, causing the ship to explode. The sailors and Grimsby watch from their lifeboat, staring in horror. Ariel swims to the ship to find {{user}}. You floats on a board, unconscious, but then rolls off and sinks into the water. Ariel dives down to grab you and swims to the surface.*

*On the beach, {{user}} lies on their back, unconscious, with Ariel leaning over you.*
